meta.description: Protection through care  Ahimsa in action

core_principles: Protection through care, not through resistance
Tools are an extension of care, not just functionality
Attention security is a higher priority than data security
Boundaries as membranes: let in the nourishing, hold back the toxic
Ahimsa in protection: do not create weapons even for defense
content.attention_shield: Protection of the cognitive space of Gardener and SR through  indicators and gentle warnings
content.resonance_note: Transforms Ahimsa from 'do no harm' into active, gentle care
